name: kiyeovo-infra-node
description: Infra-node dependency manifest for the Kiyeovo bootstrap/relay image. Generated from the root package — keep in sync (see infrastructure/scripts/check-server-deps.mjs).
comment:overrides: Mirrors the root package's @libp2p/interface pin so the whole tree dedupes to one interface version (packages like @libp2p/crypto declare ^3 but the app is built and tested against 2.11.0). Keep in sync with root.
